name: Rumors for Kravel
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I had to use some of my favors, and gave away a rare bottle of elven wine, and did some heavy deducing myself!  But I found the information you seek.

Here, I wrote a letter with some very interesting bits on our friend, Nazz Steamboil.  Do with it what you will -- it's too dangerous for me to use.

Just don't tell anyone where you got it!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Goblin Rumors to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well well! This is interesting... very interesting. Heh, perhaps I should bow to the goblin pilot the next time I see him.

This is worth plenty, adventurer. I'm sure Nazz will pay a small fortune to keep his secret... a secret.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you get anything on Nazz Steamboil? Anything he might want to keep a secret??
